full_judgment: 15. Having perused the impugned order, we find that under the title আলোচনা ও সিদ্ধান্ত’ it has been recorded that the defendant No.1, representing the said company, has establish the suit cold storage with the loan obtained from the defendant No.7 (Sonali Bank Ltd.). The suit cold storage has been mortgaged in favour of the defendant No.7 (the Bank). The cold storage was affected by the devastating flood of 1998, there was no power supply and as a result it had to stop its operation. On 20-5-2007 the defendants No. 1-3 (of Title Suit No. 31 of2001) have adopted a resolution to transfers their 100% shares and accordingly executed share transfer form (Form 117), duly affirmed by swearing three affidavits; that the plaintiffs have submitted form 117, three affidavits, application dated 04-3-2010 for power connection, a copy of trade license, a receipt showing payment of electricity bills, a mutation Khatian and a receipt showing payment of Tk. 25 lakh to the defendant No. 07 in the Court. The trial Court has also recorded that the Bank has filed Artha Rin Suit No. 574 of2005 for the realization of Tk. 3,57,98,000 against the said defendant and, after obtaining the judgment and decree in the Artha Rin Suit No. 310 of 2003, the Bank has filed Execution suit No. 574 of2005 and had tried, twice, to sell the mortgaged property in auction. But, having failed to do so the Bank has again filed second Execution Case No. 99 of 2010 and that the defendants were trying to collusively hand over the suit cold storage. Thereafter, the trial Court have found that there was no reliable documents on record to show that the plaintiff has paid to defendant No.I-3 Tk. 40 lakh to purchase the suit cold storage or that it had made payment of Tk. 1,11,49,000 to the Bank as down payment.
